newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine November production indices up yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Philippine November production indices up yr/yr.

text.p: The Philippine's value of production index was up 4.5 percent year-on-year in November to 427.20 from 408.70 in November 1995, the National Statistics Office (NSO) said on Tuesday.
The value of production index, however, declined by 4.4 percent on a month-on-month basis, the agency said.
The agency said the volume of production index rose by 1.4 percent year-on-year in November but on a month-on month basis, it went down by 4.7 percent.

Year-on-year increases in value of production were recorded in 11 out of 16 major sectors, the NSO said. These were led by miscellaneous manufactured goods with 23.9 percent growth and electrical machinery, 18.2 percent.
The apparel sector recorded the biggest drop in November of 22.2 percent on a year-on-year basis in terms of value, the NSO said.

In terms of volume, year-on-year increases were led by the glass products sector at 35.7 percent. This was followed by miscellaneous non-metallic mineral products, 24.4 percent; and iron and steel, 23.2 percent, the NSO said.
Apparel likewise posted the largest contraction in volume at 30.6 percent year-on-year.
The NSO said the figures were based on its monthly survey of key manufacturing enterprises to give flash indicators on the economy.
